svg.text: Notes
Both options share tablet and phone: file card on top, the email, the fields, History, then the fixed bar with ⋯ and Approve.
A at 1280x800: the whole form fits above the bar; the file stays put while the right column scrolls to History.
B at 1280x800: only the contractor, number, date and total show above the bar; jobs and the note need a scroll.
Tablet puts Contractor beside Invoice #; the phone stacks them. Date and Total stay side by side down to 360.
At 320: Date and Total stack (136px can't hold 'Nov 18, 2026' and the calendar); the bar keeps ⋯ plus a full-width Approve.
At 320 the Possible duplicate flag still fits on the Invoice # label row; read-only, the phone puts it under the number.
Phone drops 'Connor' from the paid line (History says who); at 320 it reads 'Paid Nov 24, Baselane' so it never truncates.
The email shows in a card like a comment card, clamped to three lines; a muted fill would read as internal.
History is ActivityTimeline: each line shows its day, and a mouse gets the full time in the tooltip.
File card Open opens the PDF in a new tab, as DocumentStage does on touch; a photo invoice opens Lightbox instead.
Possible duplicate stays on Invoice # in every stage (M10 has no dismiss) and links the other invoice; Who's this from? sits on Contractor.
Approve stays off until there is a contractor and a total; the bar's line under the buttons says which is missing.
⋯ by stage: To review, Not an invoice. To pay, Back to review and Not an invoice. Paid, Undo paid.
The ⋯ menu stays anchored above its button on every device, as menu.tsx keeps action menus; touch rows are 44px.
References: Airwallex review bill (file left, form right, Approve bottom right), Mercury and Melio bills, GoPay receipt on top.
